shortDescription: Information module for Sda Port Assignments

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: dataVlanName
options.description: DataVlanName query parameter. Data VLAN name of the port assignment.

options.name: fabricId
options.description: FabricId query parameter. ID of the fabric the device is assigned to.

options.name: interfaceName
options.description: InterfaceName query parameter. Interface name of the port assignment.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. Maximum number of records to return. The maximum number of objects supported in a single request is 500.

options.name: nativeVlanId
options.description: NativeVlanId query parameter. Native VLAN of the port assignment, this option is only applicable to TRUNKING_DEVICE connectedDeviceType.(VLAN must be between 1 and 4094. In cases value not set when connectedDeviceType is TRUNKING_DEVICE, default value will be '1').

options.name: networkDeviceId
options.description: NetworkDeviceId query parameter. Network device ID of the port assignment.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. Starting record for pagination.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.

options.name: voiceVlanName
options.description: VoiceVlanName query parameter. Voice VLAN name of the port assignment.
